source_text: Non erit homo in tabernaculo cum intrat pontifex. Solus mediator. Amen.
orientation: Origen is closing the homily by applying the Day of Atonement rite, where the high priest enters the tabernacle alone, to Christ as the sole mediator.
pass_a_gloss: There will be no man in the tabernacle when the high priest enters. He is the only mediator. Amen.

choices.english: There will be no man in the tabernacle
choices.why: Keeps the future tense and the absolute negation of the Latin, matching the ritual prohibition.
rejected: No one shall be in the tabernacle
A man will not be in the tabernacle

choices.why: Uses the glossary rendering for pontifex and preserves the temporal clause with present tense.
rejected: as the chief priest goes in
at the entry of the pontiff

choices.why: Supplies the copula for English while keeping the emphatic 'solus' as 'only' to stress Christ's unique role.

bible_refs.note: Non erit homo in tabernaculo cum intrat pontifex

pass_b_english: No one will be in the tabernacle when the high priest enters (Leviticus 16:17). He is the only mediator. Amen.
